BL-775 — Bubble Live Screen shell — a native, read-only Live Screen fed by the existing /resident-pane snapshot
What it solves: ## e2e procedure for QA
Approval context: Defaults I picked, all amendable:
(1) **Native Kotlin, not a WebView-backed staged migration.** A WebView would carry the very webview constraints this migration exists to escape, and Bubble already talks to the bridge natively.
(2) **Read-only first, Mini App untouched.** Nothing is deprecated in …
BL-775 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-775" (or "reject BL-775 <reason>") to act.
